Our client, a leading organization in the healthcare industry, is seeking a Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join their team. As a Software Quality Assurance Engineer, you will be part of the Quality Assurance Department supporting cross-functional teams across multiple locations. The ideal candidate will have a strong attention to detail, excellent collaboration skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving, which will align successfully in the organization.

Job Title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer

Location: Lake Forest, IL

What's the Job?

  • Ensure regulatory compliance for healthcare software products and related quality processes.
  • Support and maintain the effectiveness of the Quality System by identifying, addressing, and documenting non-compliance issues.
  • Perform software quality assurance and testing activities within a regulated environment.
  • Create, review, and maintain risk management documentation to evaluate and mitigate product risks.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure product safety, effectiveness, and compliance throughout the development lifecycle.

What's Needed?

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, or a closely related discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a Quality Assurance or related role.
  • Experience performing software testing in a regulated industry environment.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare industry standards, regulations, and regulatory agencies.
  • Demonstrated experience with risk management methodologies and product compliance activities.

What's in it for me?

  • Opportunity to work in a highly regulated and impactful healthcare environment.
  • Engagement with cross-functional teams across multiple locations, fostering collaboration and professional growth.
  • Chance to contribute to innovative healthcare software solutions that improve patient outcomes.
  • Supportive work environment that values quality, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Potential for career development within a dynamic organization.

Upon completion of waiting period consultants are eligible for:

  • Medical and Prescription Drug Plans
  • Dental Plan
  • Vision Plan
  • 401(k), Plus Match
  • Weekly Pay

Our client, a healthcare revenue cycle management organization, is seeking a Medical Billing Specialist to join their Revenue Cycle Management team. As a Medical Billing Specialist, you will focus on patient accounts and collections, reviewing statements and EOBs, verifying balances, and supporting accurate, timely follow-up. The ideal candidate will bring strong medical billing and insurance knowledge, clear communication for patient account inquiries, and a detail-oriented approach to resolving unpaid accounts while meeting quality and productivity standards.

Job Title:Medical Billing Specialist

Location:Lake Mary, FL (100% onsite)

Pay Range:$25/hr

What's the Job?

  • Review patient statements of account, including EOBs, to verify accuracy and enter required information.
  • Support VAD Patient Collections by reviewing patient accounts, verifying balances, and following up on outstanding patient balances.
  • Interpret EOBs (Explanation of Benefits) and use the information to resolve unpaid accounts efficiently.
  • Assist with patient collections call queue activities, including outbound and inbound calls related to billing statement inquiries.
  • Review patient credit balances and ensure account documentation is accurate and complete.

What's Needed?

  • Strong medical billing and insurance knowledge.
  • Experience with customer service and collections in a healthcare setting.
  • Ability to interpret EOBs accurately.
  • Previous experience working in a billing/customer service call queue.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills to resolve account issues while meeting quality and productivity standards.

What's in it for me?

  • Work as part of a Revenue Cycle Management team supporting patient accounts and collections.
  • Daytime Monday–Friday schedule.
  • Opportunity to apply your medical billing expertise to real patient account workflows.
  • Clear focus on statement review, EOB interpretation, and collections follow-up.
  • Start date ASAP, pending successful completion of screenings.

Our client, Pharmaceutical Development is seeking a Sr. Scientist to join their team. As a Sr. Scientist, you will be part of the Pharmaceutical Development team supporting laboratory-based biologics drug product development. The ideal candidate will have strong technical problem-solving, disciplined Good Documentation Practices (GDP), and the ability to communicate scientific results clearly across cross-functional partners, which will align successfully in the organization.

Job Title:Sr. Scientist

Location:San Diego, CA

Pay Range:$43

What's the Job?

  • Contribute to the setup, operation, maintenance, and routine troubleshooting of laboratory instruments; support method development and draft related procedures, reports, SOPs, and best-practice documentation.
  • Independently execute assigned experiments and, as experience permits, plan or lead smaller, well-defined studies supporting phase-appropriate formulation and drug product process development.
  • Analyze and interpret experimental data, identify trends or atypical results, draw scientifically supported conclusions, and recommend next steps within defined project parameters; escalate complex issues as appropriate.
  • Draft study plans, development reports, technical memos, and other scientific documentation with review from more experienced colleagues or management as appropriate.
  • Collaborate with project management, quality assurance, analytical, R&D, non-clinical, manufacturing, and external partners to support development activities, technology transfer, and clinical material production.

What's Needed?

  • Experience with LC and iCiEF is required.
  • Hands-on experience with state-of-the-art bioanalytical methods and characterization in a biologics drug product laboratory, including UPLC or HPLC (SEC, RP, HIC, IEX/CEX, CAD preferred), charge variant analysis, particle analysis, CE-SDS, and other physical-property characterization.
  • Strong understanding of biochemical and physical properties of therapeutic biologics (proteins and related modalities) and commonly used protein quantification and characterization approaches.
  • Ability to analyze testing results, recognize trends and out-of-trend or atypical data, and summarize findings with scientifically supported conclusions and recommendations within defined parameters.
  • Strong technical writing skills and demonstrated Good Documentation Practices (GDP) with disciplined laboratory record keeping in a pharmaceutical or similarly regulated environment.

What's in it for me?

  • Work on meaningful, laboratory-based biologics drug product development using modern analytical instrumentation and methods.
  • Build confidence by executing experiments independently and contributing to study planning and optimization as you grow.
  • Strengthen your scientific communication by drafting clear study documentation and presenting results and recommendations to the project team.
  • Collaborate with internal and external partners to support development activities, technology transfer, and clinical material production.
  • Join a fast-paced team environment where you can prioritize multiple work items and drive progress with accuracy and efficiency.

Our client, a technology organization focused on delivering secure, scalable automation solutions, is seeking an AI Automation Engineer to join their team. As an AI Automation Engineer, you will be part of the engineering organization supporting delivery of AI-enabled workflows and deterministic automation capabilities. The ideal candidate will have strong technical leadership, a quality-first mindset, and the ability to collaborate across engineering and delivery teams to turn requirements into reliable production solutions.

Job Title:AI Automation Engineer

Location:Chandler, AZ (Local only) - Hybrid (3 days onsite required)

Pay Range:

What's the Job?

  • Lead refinement of stories and technical requirements for AI agent use-cases, orchestration workflows, and deterministic automation capabilities.
  • Participate in and help guide estimation of work necessary to deliver stories and requirements across both agentic and deterministic automation implementations.
  • Perform spikes, proofs of concept, and technical experiments to reduce delivery risk, validate design choices, and inform implementation direction.
  • Design, code, and review solution components and unit tests to deliver requirements and stories in accordance with acceptance criteria, control requirements, and engineering standards.
  • Support secure, observable, and supportable solution delivery by implementing and promoting appropriate logging, validation, exception handling, resiliency measures, and operational controls.

What's Needed?

  • Strong experience developing complex software or automation solutions that translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable, and supportable technical capabilities.
  • Advanced programming and scripting skills in languages commonly used for software engineering, API development, orchestration, and automation implementation.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across both AI-enabled use-cases and deterministic automation patterns, with flexibility to support either based on delivery demand.
  • Strong understanding of workflow orchestration, execution control, task sequencing, and operational logic required to move from intent or decisioning to controlled action.
  • Strong knowledge of software development lifecycle practices including design, coding, code review, testing, version control, release management, and deployment support.

What's in it for me?

  • Opportunity to help shape modern, Agile solution delivery practices and advocate for great design and engineering standards.
  • Chance to build reusable components that power AI-enabled workflows, agent interactions, orchestration logic, and deterministic automation routines.
  • Work on complex, real-world technical challenges involving integration, orchestration, execution logic, runtime reliability, and supportability.
  • Collaborate across architecture, engineering, automation, and delivery teams to drive integrated outcomes and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor and guide less senior engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and day-to-day implementation support.

Our client, a leader in the pharmaceutical and life sciences industry, is seeking a Chromeleon System Administrator to join their team. As a Chromeleon System Administrator, you will be part of the Laboratory Informatics support team, ensuring the seamless operation and enhancement of enterprise Chromeleon Chromatography Data System (CDS) applications. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, excellent communication, and a proactive approach, which will align successfully in the organization.

Job Title: Chromeleon System Administrator

Location: Cincinnati, OH (Onsite)

Pay Range:$50/hr on W2 

What's the Job?

  • Develop, enhance, and support enterprise Chromeleon CDS applications using the SDK and customization tools.
  • Integrate laboratory applications such as Chromeleon with other enterprise systems like Nexus LIMS.
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
  • Perform incident resolution, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis for complex application issues.
  • Support application deployment, upgrades, patches, and validation activities to ensure compliance with GxP and FDA standards.

What's Needed?

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 4-8+ years of experience in enterprise application development and support.
  • Hands-on experience with Chromeleon SDK development and customization.
  • Strong SQL development and database design skills, including T-SQL, stored procedures, and database objects.
  • Experience working in regulated environments such as pharmaceutical or biotech industries, with knowledge of GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, and CSV standards.

What's in it for me?

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge laboratory informatics systems within a global organization.
  • Engage in meaningful projects that impact the quality and compliance of pharmaceutical products.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and industry experts to enhance your skills and expertise.

Our client, a technology organization supporting enterprise platforms, is seeking a Systems Operations Engineer 3 - Contingent to join their team. As a Systems Operations Engineer 3 - Contingent, you will be part of the Cyber Security - Platform Support Enterprise Service Technology organization, supporting the applications and infrastructure that keep critical services running. The ideal candidate will bring strong incident and problem management skills, a proactive mindset for identifying recurring issues, and the communication confidence to drive issues to closure with cross-functional partners.

Job Title:Systems Operations Engineer 

Location:1525 West WT Harris Blvd, Charlotte, NC 28262 and 2600 S Price Rd., Chandler, Arizona 85286 (Hybrid work schedule: 3 days in office, minimum)

What's the Job?

  • Provide day-to-day platform support for Enterprise Services Technology applications and infrastructure, focusing on stability, security, scalability, speed, and cost.
  • Participate in complex technical issues and initiatives involving large-scale applications, systems, databases, and related technical products and services.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure and application teams to lead, monitor, and resolve system outages while supporting availability management.
  • Recognize recurring problems and proactively recommend solutions and process improvements with cross-functional partners.
  • Serve as a key participant in large-scale computer systems and network infrastructure operations for Systems and Operations.

What's Needed?

  • 2+ years of Systems Engineering experience (or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of work experience, training, military experience, and/or education).
  • Flexibility to work in a 24/7 environment, including weekends and holidays, and on-call basis based on demands, with willingness to work beyond shift hours if needed.
  • Working knowledge of varying technologies, including Linux, Autosys, Windows OS, Harness, ServiceNow, TFE, Cloud Management Portal, Big Panda, AppDynamics, ThousandEyes, and Splunk.
  • Proficient experience with incident management, problem management, and change management.
  • Ability to adhere to HR policies, shift availability, team meetings, and daily cadence.

What's in it for me?

  • Opportunity to support enterprise platforms where reliability, security, and performance directly impact critical services.
  • Work in a collaborative environment with infrastructure, application teams, and management to drive outages and operational issues to closure.
  • Chance to strengthen your production support expertise in a highly critical environment and expand your technology toolkit.
  • Structured expectations around shift coverage and operational cadence, helping you stay aligned and effective.
  • Motivating, high-impact work where urgency, ownership, and solution focus matter every day.

Important Shift Availability Requirement:

  • CANDIDATES MUST BE AVAILABLE FRIDAY - TUESDAY SHIFT. DO NOT SUBMIT CANDIDATES NOT OPEN TO THE LISTED SHIFT.
  • Shift availability: Friday–Tuesday, 9:00am–6:00pm.
  • Must be available for shift coverage and support as operational demands require.
